lines.en: label sanafirsthall:
scene sanahall1
: Hey, Sana. Why are you just standing out here?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sana。你干嘛只是站在这儿？

lines.en: : Oh...umm...hi, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯……你好，老师……

lines.en: scene sanahall2
: I don’t...really know...
lines.zh: : 我……不太清楚……

lines.en: : I just felt like...I was supposed to...for some reason...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得……我该这么做……不知道为什么……

lines.en: : Well, that's weird. But I guess I'm not really one to talk given my circumstances for being here.
lines.zh: : 好吧，是挺奇怪的。不过考虑到我来这儿的原因，我大概也没什么资格说别人。

lines.en: : What...kind of circumstances are-
lines.zh: : 什么样的……原因——

lines.en: : Anyway, want to talk for a little while? Might help the two of us kill some time.
lines.zh: : 总之，想聊一会儿吗？也许能帮我们两个打发点时间。

lines.en: : Assuming you're not busy, of course. Which I doubt you are since you're kind of just...standing here.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是你不忙。不过我看你八成不忙，因为你基本上就是在……站着。

lines.en: scene sanahall3
: Y-Yeah...I'm not doing anything...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……我没在做什么……

lines.en: : My mom is handling the bar to...give me time to study, but...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈在看店，好……给我时间学习，可是……

lines.en: : Studying is kind of...really boring...
lines.zh: : 学习这事儿……真的很无聊……

lines.en: : I can help you if you want. You might not know this, but I'm actually a teacher.
lines.zh: : 你想的话我可以帮你。你可能不知道，但我其实是个老师。

lines.en: : I had...no idea...
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道……

lines.en: : I think I’ll...be okay, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得……我自己能行的……

lines.en: : We can talk about something else instead...Something that doesn't make me want to fall asleep...
lines.zh: : 我们可以聊点别的……一些不会让我想睡觉的东西……

lines.en: : Sounds good. Maybe you can tell me a little about what your mom is like?
lines.zh: : 听起来不错。也许你可以跟我说说你妈妈是什么样的人？

lines.en: scene sanahall3r
: My...mom? Why do you want to know about her?...
lines.zh: : 我……妈妈？你为什么想了解她？……

lines.en: : Just wondering if that’s where you get any of your qualities from. The idea of an entire family of timid cyclops girls is quite amusing to me.
lines.zh: : 只是想知道你是不是从她那儿继承了什么特质。一整家子都是胆小的独眼女孩——这个念头让我觉得相当好笑。

lines.en: : You...do know I...have a second eye...right?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道我……还有另一只眼睛吧？……

lines.en: : If you say so, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你说是就是吧，Sana。

lines.en: : Uhh...anyway...
scene sanahall4
: My mom and I...aren't really that much alike...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈和我……其实没那么像……

lines.en: : I...do look like her, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我确实长得像她……

lines.en: As much as I like Sana for her current appearance, I can't help but wonder what an aged up version would look like.
lines.zh: 尽管我喜欢 Sana 现在的样子，我还是忍不住好奇她上了年纪会是什么模样。

lines.en: I'm sure I won't have to wonder for long, though. The two of us are bound to cross paths eventually.
lines.zh: 不过我肯定不用好奇太久。我们两个迟早会再碰上的。

lines.en: : I’m guessing your mom's a lot more talkative than you are?
lines.zh: : 我猜你妈妈可比你话多得多？

lines.en: scene sanahall5
: That’s...one way to put it...
lines.zh: : 可以……这么说吧……

lines.en: : She’s...umm...
: Just...just go ahead and assume she's my...exact opposite...
lines.zh: : 就……就干脆当她是我……完全相反的人吧……

lines.en: scene sanahall4
: You’ll...find out whenever you meet her...
lines.zh: : 你……见到她就知道了……

lines.en: : Any way I describe her would...make her sound a lot worse than...she actually is...
lines.zh: : 不管我怎么描述她，都会……让她听起来比……实际的她糟糕得多……

lines.en: : That's...an interesting way to describe your mother. But I'll take your word for it.
lines.zh: : 这倒是……描述你母亲的有趣方式。不过我相信你的话。

lines.en: : How are things with Ayane, then? I'm a little curious as to how you two ended up in the same dorm together.
lines.zh: : 那你和 Ayane 相处得怎么样？我有点好奇你们两个怎么会住进同一间宿舍。

lines.en: scene sanahall5r
: That just...kind of happened, I guess?
lines.zh: : 那只是……就这么发生了吧，大概？

lines.en: : I...don’t really have any friends other than her...And Ami and Maya were already together, so...
lines.zh: : 我……除了她基本没有别的朋友……而 Ami 和 Maya 已经住一起了，所以……

lines.en: : Process of elimination?
lines.zh: : 排除法？

lines.en: : That makes it sound incredibly depressing.
lines.zh: : 这么说听起来可太惨了。

lines.en: scene sanahall6
: I know, but...it really isn't like that...
lines.zh: : 我知道，可是……真的不是那样……

lines.en: : We...actually are good friends, so...
lines.zh: : 我们……其实是好朋友，所以……

lines.en: : You don't have to...feel bad for me or anything...
lines.zh: : 你不用……为我难过什么的……

lines.en: : Great. Because that whole sympathy thing isn't really one of my strong suits.
lines.zh: : 太好了。因为同情这种事本来就不是我的强项。

lines.en: scene sanahall4
: I'm not sure if...I understand what you mean by that, but...I like living with Ayane...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……我懂不懂你的意思，不过……我喜欢和 Ayane 住在一起……

lines.en: : She kind of...makes up for all of the things I'm lacking in...
lines.zh: : 她有点……弥补了我所有欠缺的东西……

lines.en: : I just wish...she'd listen to...better music every once in a while...
lines.zh: : 我只是希望……她偶尔能听听……更好听的音乐……

lines.en: I guess there is that whole saying about how opposites attract, so it's not bizarre to assume Ayane and Sana pair well together.
lines.zh: 大概就是所谓“异极相吸”吧，所以认为 Ayane 和 Sana 很搭并不奇怪。

lines.en: Lump the quietest girl together with the most talkative one and there's sure to be some sort of...dynamic there.
lines.zh: 把最安静的女孩和最话痨的女孩凑一对，肯定会产生某种……化学反应。

lines.en: But to have both her best friend and her mother be completely different from her?
lines.zh: 但她最好的朋友和她母亲都和她截然不同？

lines.en: I feel like that could get...exhausting.
lines.zh: 我觉得那可能会……很累人。

lines.en: : Well, I’m happy you're comfortable around her. That makes one of us.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你和她相处得自在。这至少让我们中有一个是自在的。

lines.en: scene sanahall5r
: I know she...comes on strong...especially with you...
lines.zh: : 我知道她……攻势很猛……尤其是对你……

lines.en: : But...I don't think you...have any reason to feel uncomfortable, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 但……我觉得你……没有理由感到不自在啊，老师……

lines.en: : We'll see about that, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，走着瞧吧。

lines.en: : In the meantime, though, I'll let you get back to your compulsion to stand around the hall and neglect your education.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我还是让你回去继续你那个在走廊里站着、荒废学业的强迫症吧。

lines.en: : Oh...okay...I...
: I guess I'll...see you later, then?...
lines.zh: : 那我猜……我们回头见？……

lines.en: : I'm sure you will. I plan on spending a lot of time in this hallway.
lines.zh: : 肯定会的。我打算在这条走廊上消磨大量时间。

lines.en: : I'm not really sure how I...feel about that...
lines.zh: : 我不太确定自己……对此是什么感觉……

lines.en: scene black
Sana and I talk for another minute or so before I leave the dorms and get on with my night.
lines.zh: Sana 和我又聊了一分钟左右，之后我离开宿舍，继续我的夜晚。

lines.en: She did mostly well this time, but I know that she's the type to get burned out by extensive conversations, so I figure it’s best to just leave her alone after a while.
lines.zh: 她这次大体表现不错，但我知道她是那种会被长时间对话耗尽的类型，所以我觉得过一阵子最好还是让她一个人待着。

lines.en: As I step outside, I ponder what a fully adjusted and comfortable Sana Sakakibara would be like.
lines.zh: 走到外面时，我琢磨着一个完全适应、完全自在的 Sana Sakakibara 会是什么样子。

lines.en: There's no way she can stay so reclusive forever, is there?
lines.zh: 她不可能永远这么孤僻下去吧，是吗？

lines.en: I wonder how long it will be until I can see a new side of her?
lines.zh: 我好奇还要多久才能看到她的另一面？

lines.en: I wonder if I'll like that one even more.
lines.zh: 我好奇我会不会更喜欢那一面。

lines.en: $ sanafirsthall = True
$ sana_love += 1
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]!
